title: Simple n-vectors: Gram-determinant norm and change of frame (parent P1)
statement: For all P, n and every family v = (v₁,…,v_n) in ℝ^P, the operator norm of the simple n-vector simpleNVector v (the functional α ↦ α(v₁,…,v_n) on n-covectors, which carry the multilinear operator norm) satisfies ‖simpleNVector v‖² = det(⟨v_i, v_j⟩)_{i,j}; and for every real n×n matrix B and every τ = (τ₁,…,τ_n) in ℝ^P, simpleNVector(i ↦ Σ_j B_ij τ_j) = det(B)·simpleNVector τ.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Eucl P), ‖simpleNVector v‖ ^ 2 = (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)).det) ∧ ∀ (P n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (τ : Fin n → Eucl P), simpleNVector (fun i => ∑ j, B i j • τ j) = B.det • simpleNVector τ
